sourceOccurrences.label: Square-root Laplace deficits and tail bounds
sourceOccurrences.note: Fourteen public results give the analytic MIFH implication with extended natural volumes and a nontrivial generating-function witness. No exact tail equivalent or local limit is asserted. Source pin: 3978a2fa0ec425729f6e15fbc3c6a142cfa4a672.

sourceOccurrences.label: Critical offspring transforms
sourceOccurrences.note: Seventeen public results prove the second-order expansion, unique transform root and its square-root asymptotic. A finite second factorial moment suffices; identification with a progeny law is separate. Source pin: 3978a2fa0ec425729f6e15fbc3c6a142cfa4a672.

Dwass reduces progeny probabilities to a central lattice coefficient, computed directly by Fourier inversion under finite positive variance. Critical extinction justifies the concluding tail comparison; the local proof does not use a Tauberian implication.
The equal-time correspondence controls distortion, roots and the coupled mass measures. Edge-to-child coupling compares contour occupation with uniform vertex mass.
